_comment: Synthetic farmer utterances. 'keys' are the words an intake MUST get right; scored separately from WER.

lines.text: Hello madam, my cow is sick since yesterday, she is not eating anything.
My buffalo is not taking feed from two days.
It is a goat. Three goats are having loose motions.
My name is Basavaraju.
I am calling from Hosahalli village, Ramanagara district.
She is not able to stand up, she is lying down only.
Her stomach is bloated on the left side and she is breathing very fast.
No, no treatment we have not given.
We gave some medicine from the local shop, I don't know the name.
My number is nine eight four five six seven two three one zero.
Only one animal. The calf is fine.
There is foam coming from her mouth and she is limping.
Sorry, not three days, it started two days back.
Yes, that is correct.
I don't know when it started, my son was looking after her.
Two sheep are having fever and there are lumps on the skin.
My name is Lakshmamma, from Kunigal taluk, Tumakuru district.
The milk has reduced a lot and there is blood in the milk.
Ummm, hello? Can you hear me? My bullock is having a wound on the leg.
No, she is standing, but walking very slowly.
It is a jersey cow, five years old, pregnant.
The village name is Doddaballapur.
Four hens died this morning, others are also dull.
She delivered a calf yesterday night and now she is not getting up.
There is swelling in the udder and it is very hot.
No, I don't have a phone number, this is my neighbour's phone.
My pig is shivering and has red patches.
My name is Mohammed Irfan, Channapatna.
The vet doctor gave injection last week but no improvement.
What? Sorry, I did not understand. Say again.
